name: Tandemaus
description: Tandemaus, the Couple Pokémon. Able to evolve into Maushold Family of Three or Maushold Family of Four . A Normal type.
pokedex_entries: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.
The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
